content.text: The assignment section fully matches our preferred position; 24.3 is expressly limited to "other assignments" and does not undercut 24.1.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates. Customer shall give prompt written notice, and the assignee shall assume the applicable obligations.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position in full. 24.1 gives Customer an unrestricted right to assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (notice only). 24.2 binds Vendor asymmetrically in our favour: no assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (reasonableness standard qualified by capability/financial standing), and never to a direct Customer competitor. 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control, and requires cooperation with successor administration. 24.3 does not undercut 24.1: by its terms it applies only to "other assignments" — i.e. those outside the carve-outs in 24.1 and 24.2 — and applies a mutual not-unreasonably-withheld consent standard. Section 13.3 is consistent, permitting transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with a Section 24 assignment. No redline required.
